# lumos_entitlement_app_store_settings (Data Source)

EntitlementAppStoreSettings DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lumos_entitlement_app_store_settings" "my_entitlementappstoresettings" {
  entitlement_uuid = "...my_entitlement_uuid..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `entitlement_uuid` (String)

### Read-Only

- `allowed_requester_groups_override` (Attributes List) Groups whose members may request this entitlement, overriding the app's allowed requester groups. Null means this entitlement inherits the app's allowed requester groups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allowed_requester_groups_override))
- `request_validation_webhook` (Attributes) The inline webhook called to validate access requests for this entitlement. This is configured directly on the entitlement; null means no webhook is configured (there is no inheritance from the app). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--request_validation_webhook))
- `time_based_access_override` (Attributes) This entitlement's own time-based access options. Null means this entitlement inherits the app's time-based access options. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--time_based_access_override))
- `visible_in_appstore` (Boolean) Whether this entitlement is visible in the App Store catalog.

<a id="nestedatt--allowed_requester_groups_override"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allowed_requester_groups_override`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The UUID of the group.


<a id="nestedatt--request_validation_webhook"></a>
### Nested Schema for `request_validation_webhook`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The UUID of the inline webhook.


<a id="nestedatt--time_based_access_override"></a>
### Nested Schema for `time_based_access_override`

Read-Only:

- `options` (Attributes List) This entitlement's own time-based access options, overriding the app's. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--time_based_access_override--options))

<a id="nestedatt--time_based_access_override--options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `time_based_access_override.options`

Read-Only:

- `label` (String) Display label for this time-based access option.
- `value_seconds` (Number) Duration in seconds. Null indicates a permanent (unlimited) access option.
